reviewer_type: Simulated author visual inspection; separate root acceptance pending

findings.evidence: Current canonical register values Pending/Rejected and long state prose use readable full-width text; all affected changed endpoint and motion frames inspected.

Frozen stable t1/t2/t3 metadata emits actual buffer-to-client routes. Fresh event4 and event7 motion in all four profiles shows one then two distinct carriers with source retention and exact Finish endpoints.
Task marker/ledger and plot axis/legend/point-index regions remain separated and readable in final endpoints and representative motion.

Shared primitive dims before-geometry during a pending action, including some retained series. Paths remain visible, active markers/ledger and retained pools remain readable, and actual topology release waits for commit. Root explicitly accepted this bounded transition style; selective series pulsing is future polish.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Fresh actual canonical chapter captures of every owned case/state in four width/theme profiles. Manually inspected 241 changed PNGs in native unscaled 765px desktop/329px narrow contacts, with full PNG followups for controls and first-token motion. Reused 87 exact decoded-pixel matches only after verifying historical per-state/profile basename, byte SHA and visually_inspected proof. Contacts preserve scene/result/metrics and captions; full PNGs retained.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Inspected all 36 fresh actual chapter in-flight PNGs from real Next/Pause/Finish: one nontrivial selected base-case transition in each lesson/profile plus event7 supplementary delivery in every profile. Requested 350ms; actual animation times, committed-before/during state and exact finished endpoint recorded per sample. Native unscaled contacts and full-size first-token frames.

semantic_rechecks: Context working-set residency is distinct from compatible selection; the changed request recomputes all suffix positions even where token text matches.
Prefix cache owns resident radix blocks; active/eligible markers distinguish live-path dependency from cache residency.
Search visits/mean refer only to the retained root-to-B edge; new leaf statistics are explicitly separate and omitted.
Cancellation prefix is syntactically completable when the unknown force key arrives; local rejection is separate from service acknowledgement/release.
